verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly claim TruffleHog scans beyond git repos into Docker images, object stores (S3), logs, chats, wikis, etc., which directly matches the story's non-git-source scanning claim. However, the hands-on probe evidence only exercises git-based scanning (GitHub repo and local fixture) — there is no independent or hands-on confirmation that S3, Docker image, or CI-log scanning actually works as documented, and one community comment even notes a user couldn't find a Docker-image-secrets tool comparable to TruffleHog, casting some doubt on real-world coverage of that specific source. Missing for 10: hands-on/independent verification of S3 bucket scanning, Docker image scanning, and CI log scanning specifically.
